title: All Five

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: Democrats took Congress and Georgia made history, but strikes on Iran, Ukraine's toll of 31 and North Korea's missiles weighed harder. Five survived three months adrift, and all five genetic letters turned up in an ancient asteroid.

lines: Three months gone in a small boat,
then Kiribati, and five came in
on a slow and ordinary tide.
the strait still wears its guns,
and a Georgia door that never swung
All five letters on a stone
All five living off the boat.
